'''Imperial Mobile Surgical Units''',<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> or '''IMSUs'''<ref name="TCSWE99">{{CSWECite|II|99|IMSU}}</ref> (pronounced '''Imsoos''')<ref name="Author's Cut 11" /> were the field [[Medcenter/Legends|hospitals]] utilized by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. These mobile hospitals could be set up near the front lines of battle and moved if the fighting got too close similar to the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Units]] used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCSWE93" />
